svg.title: GLM 5.3 Flash vs Muse Spark 1.3 (max)
svg.desc: Muse Spark leads on intelligence index, both coding benchmarks, and output speed. GLM 5.3 Flash leads on time to first token and price, at roughly an eighth of the cost. Context window is equal at 1M tokens.

g.text: For coding, Muse Spark scores higher on both benchmarks. GLM 5.3 Flash costs roughly 8x less.
Beyond coding, GLM 5.3 Flash answers faster to first token. Muse Spark streams faster once it starts.
Longer bar means better. Index, speed, latency, and price: Artificial Analysis. Coding benchmarks: AI Release Tracker and LLM Stats.
Values change as providers and benchmarks update.
